map.多半是位宽或字符集不匹配。若编码时按 UTF-8 输出（一个汉字 3 字节），解: It is usually a bit-width or character-set mismatch. If the encoder wrote UTF-8 (3 bytes per Chinese character) but the decoder treats every 8 bits as an ASCII character, the non-ASCII part turns into mojibake; likewise, a string encoded as 7-bit ASCII decodes out of alignment when read as 8-bit. Confirm the original bit width and character set before decoding.
